_comment: YOUR architecture, unchanged: 4 independent ResNet-18 backbones (44.7M params) combined by Active Normalization. The ONLY change is when the experts fork. The reference run forked at round 0 from a 1-round warmup, so each expert learned representations from scratch on a quarter of the data - the measured cause of its 14-point loss to FedAvg. Here a global model is trained on all 40 clients for 25 rounds first, then forked into 4 experts and fine-tuned for 50. Note: warmup rounds use ALL clients, so they cost ~4x a 25%-participation round; total budget is ~3000 client-epochs vs the reference's ~2160. Report that difference. FedAvg is not retrained - reuse 0.4895 from the reference run.
